About the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position

A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A bird of prey carrying a snake has been custom painted on this CZ75. A snake eater, minus the catchy theme song The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position is a Restricted-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Pole Position finish on the CZ75-Auto. With a Restricted rarity classification, it has approximately a ~3.2% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position can be unboxed from the Chroma 2 Case. It belongs to the Chroma 2 Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.70. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $8.45, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $1.20 (Battle-Scarred) to $8.45 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position has a community rating of 3.4 out of 5 based on 931 votes. This mixed rating suggests the design appeals to some players while others prefer alternative finishes.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position?

Factory New (FN) CZ75-Auto | Pole Position skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Pole Position pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position a good budget option?

Yes, the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position is an excellent budget-friendly choice. Priced affordably, it offers the Pole Position aesthetic without breaking the bank. Budget skins like this are ideal for players building their first inventory or those who prefer spending on multiple skins rather than one expensive item. The lower price point also means less financial risk if you decide to trade or sell later.

What is the float value range for the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.70, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position?

Prices for the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Chroma 2 Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position price going up or down?

The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position from?

The CZ75-Auto | Pole Position is part of the The Chroma 2 Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Chroma 2 Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the CZ75-Auto | Pole Position?

The in-game description reads: "A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A bird of prey carrying a snake has been custom painted on this CZ75. A snake eater, minus the catchy theme song" The Pole Position finish on the CZ75-Auto is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
